sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, Color Wall Ball - Flappy Ball is a puzzle game where you control a ball that bounces around a colorful grid. Your goal is to match the color of the ball with the lines on the grid to progress through the levels. The game starts with simple levels where the lines are stationary, but as you progress, the lines begin to move, adding an extra layer of difficulty to the game. You'll need to time your jumps perfectly to match the color of the ball with the lines. If you fail to match the colors, the ball will bounce off, and you'll lose a life. The game ends when you lose all your lives.

The controls of the game are extremely simple and intuitive. You can use your mouse, keyboard, or touch controls to play the game. The ball will bounce accordingly, and you'll need to adjust your timing to match the color of the ball with the lines. The game also features a reset button, which allows you to restart the level from the beginning.

As you progress through the levels, the game introduces new elements, such as obstacles, power-ups, and special lines that can help or hinder your progress. These elements add variety to the game and make it more challenging and engaging. The game also features a high score system, which allows you to compete with your friends and other players online.
